# The first mutation run fails with a lived mutant. The head gets no review: the fix lane gets the finding first.
# The fixed head gets a clean mutation run, then its review.
exec beehave run 7 --workflow flow/workflow.star
stdout 'item 7 finished'

exec beehave status
stdout '^item-7-r1\tdone\tgate pass at [0-9a-f]+\tfix 1 of 5\treview 1 of 6'

# The job runs on the build host in the slot class, with the base ref of the round as its last word.
grep -count=2 '^build mutation sh mutation.sh origin/integration$' mutation.log

grep -count=1 '^implement ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^fix 1 ' calls.log
! grep '^fix 2 ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^review ' calls.log
grep -count=1 '^The mutation run failed. Each line is one finding:$' findings.log
grep -count=1 '^- internal/a.go:12: a mutant lived: CONDITIONALS_NEGATION$' findings.log
! grep 'KILLED' findings.log

cmp events.log expected-events.log

-- mutations --
lived
clean
-- verdicts --
approve
-- expected-events.log --
claim 7
release 7
